tools.name: Smart Grain
tools.description: Preserve original grain and match grain in edited areas.
tools.detail: Preserves the original plate’s captured grain in unchanged areas and generates matched grain where your comp differs from the denoised plate. Match against a representative frame, then finish the shot with one effect.
tools.install: Extract the ZIP, close After Effects, then run Install.cmd. Restart AE and find EVFX Smart Grain v2 in the EVFX effects category. Select your original and denoised plates, then click Match Grain at Full resolution.

readiness.evidence: EVFXSmartGrain/docs/smartfx-bounds-validation.md: current 2.2.3 AEX and live AE opening/render checks.

tools.name: Smart Denoise
tools.description: Reduce noise with automatic analysis and spatial and temporal filtering.
tools.detail: Noise-profile-based denoising with automatic analysis, temporal filtering, NVIDIA CUDA acceleration and CPU fallback.
tools.requirements: Windows x64 · After Effects · 8 / 16 / 32 bpc · NVIDIA CUDA optional
tools.install: Extract the ZIP, close After Effects, run Install.cmd, and restart After Effects.

readiness.evidence: EVFXSmartGrain/denoise/docs/validation-v1.0.3.md: final native AE render and geometry checks; playback and ROI interaction not verified.
readiness.note: After Effects identifies this as a development build. Playback and ROI interaction remain unverified; test it in a backup project.

tools.name: Blurry
tools.description: GPU lens blur with combined or separate layer inputs, per-layer blur amounts, depth maps, Background Layer protection and an alpha Holdout Layer. Automatic 2D links and CPU fallback included.
tools.detail: GPU lens blur with combined or separate layer inputs, per-layer blur amounts, depth maps, Background Layer protection and an alpha Holdout Layer. Automatic 2D links and CPU fallback included.
tools.install: Extract the entire ZIP, close AE, and run Install.cmd. The package includes its OpenMP runtime. Restart AE and apply EVFX Blurry v2. Start with Lens Blur (No Depth Map) > Blur Diameter. Supported 2D composition-space links initialize automatically; Link / Refresh is an optional repair action.

readiness.evidence: EVFX Blurry/docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md: core/adapter regression suites and AE 2026 smoke checks; documented scope limits.

tools.name: PixelPicker
tools.description: Sample up to eight colours and generate gradients.
tools.detail: Up to eight Live, Frozen or Custom colour samplers, smooth and ordered gradients, and tracked-null sampler layouts.
tools.install: Close After Effects. Copy EVFX_PixelPicker.aex to the shared Adobe MediaCore plug-ins folder, then restart AE. Keep only one copy of this build.

readiness.evidence: Active PixelPicker worktree: docs/HANDOFF.md and docs/QA-RESULTS.md; exact installed AEX hash verified.
readiness.note: Interactive sampler handles, overlay responsiveness and Follow Null refresh still need verification.

tools.name: Auto Levels
tools.description: Match foreground black and white levels to a reference plate.
tools.detail: Matches foreground shadow and highlight luminance to a background plate across red, green, and blue channels. The native SmartFX effect includes keyframeable strength and gamma controls.
tools.install: Close AE and copy EVFX_AutoLevels.aex into Adobe’s shared MediaCore plug-ins folder. Restart AE, apply Auto Levels from the EVFX category, and choose your background reference.

readiness.evidence: EVFX Auto Levels/README.md and docs/plugin_build_guide.md: build/use instructions; no completed host-acceptance report found.
readiness.note: No recorded AE runtime test. Check reference sampling and renders on a test project.

tools.name: Crop
tools.description: Crop layers from rendered alpha; preview and prerender.
tools.detail: Crops from rendered alpha with editable previews, duration and mask crops, and recoverable prerenders. A native effect and dockable panel keep the crop workflow inside After Effects.
tools.install: Extract the ZIP and follow the included README and installer instructions. Restart After Effects, then open EVFX Crop from the Window menu or the installed layer menu.

readiness.evidence: EVFX Crop/docs/VERIFICATION.md: Limits; open feature tickets and pending dock review.
readiness.note: Incomplete: translation, mask bypass/deletion and alpha expansion. Dock restoration still needs visual verification.

tools.name: Multilayer EXR
tools.description: Combine render passes into multilayer OpenEXR sequences.
tools.detail: An After Effects panel and Python helper for assembling render passes into multilayer OpenEXR files. The Windows setup detects installed AE versions and handles panel and helper installation.
tools.requirements: Windows · After Effects · Setup installs Python dependencies
tools.install: Run the setup executable and follow the prompts. Internet access may be needed for Python and EXR dependencies. Restart After Effects and open the EVFX Multilayer EXR panel from Window.

readiness.evidence: EVFX Multilayer EXR for AE/README.md and docs/antigravity/walkthrough.md: installation and backend workflow documentation.
readiness.note: The installer and complete AE workflow have no recorded end-to-end test.

tools.name: 3D Null Tracker
tools.description: Build 3D camera motion and nulls from 2D tracks.
tools.detail: Builds camera motion, depth-aware nulls, and solids from existing 2D point tracks. Includes camera solving, parallax tools, scene origin and scale normalization, and quick VFX rigs. Tracking quality depends on your input tracks and depth assumptions.
tools.install: Copy EVFX_3D_Null_Tracker.jsx to AE’s Scripts/ScriptUI Panels folder and restart AE. Open it from Window, select your tracked nulls, and add them to the solve list. See the included guide for depth setup.

readiness.evidence: EVFX 3d Null Tracker/README.md: described solver and setup; no separate runtime-acceptance report present.
readiness.note: Camera solving and tracking accuracy have no recorded runtime test.

tools.name: Shot QC
tools.description: Store shot status, reviewer and notes inside an AE project.
tools.detail: Stores a shot’s QC status, shot ID, reviewer, and notes in an After Effects effect instance. Includes a passed checkbox and optional preview overlay. An early development build for trying the workflow.
tools.requirements: Windows x64 · After Effects · Development build
tools.install: Close AE and copy EVFXShotQC.aex into Adobe’s shared MediaCore plug-ins folder. Restart AE and search for EVFX Shot QC. Keep a backup when evaluating development builds.

readiness.evidence: EVFX-AE-Collection/plugins/EVFXShotQC/README.md: MVP and external import/sync listed as a next step.
readiness.note: Experimental: JSON import/sync is unfinished; runtime stability is unverified.

tools.name: Crop for Blender
tools.description: Render a subject region with full-frame placement metadata.
tools.detail: Renders a padded camera-space region around a moving subject while retaining the original projection and pixel density. Exports cropped 32-bit RGBA EXRs with placement metadata and reconstructs full-resolution sequences.
tools.requirements: Blender · Cycles · See package for version requirements
tools.install: Install the ZIP as a Blender add-on, enable EVFX Crop, and open the EVFX tab in the 3D View sidebar. Set your camera and output settings, choose the subject, then render the subject region.

readiness.evidence: evfx crop for blender/README.md: EVFX-017 stabilization playback pending visible verification.
readiness.note: Stabilization playback is unverified. Cropped denoising can differ from a full-frame render.

tools.name: Sequencer

tools.detail: A native image-sequence and movie viewer. Open a frame to load its numbered sequence, bring in multiple shots, or drag media straight in. Includes playback and inspection tools for reviewing VFX media.

tools.name: Menu
tools.description: Downscale and denoise videos from Windows Explorer.
tools.detail: Adds plate downscaling and denoising to Windows Explorer. Halve a plate’s resolution or choose a denoise strength from a small progress window. Runs on the CPU with a bundled helper for supported 12-bit ProRes formats.
tools.requirements: Windows · Python with tkinter · FFmpeg + ffprobe
tools.install: Extract the entire ZIP, ensure Python and FFmpeg/ffprobe are installed, then double-click Install.cmd in Explorer. Right-click a supported movie and choose EVFX Menu. Windows 11 may place it under Show more options.

readiness.evidence: EVFX Menu/README.md and bin/validation.json: tested processing formats and bundled encoder verification; supported input limits remain explicit.

tools.name: Corridor Key 2.0
tools.description: Subject masking and RGBA matting with CorridorKey 2.0.
tools.detail: A standalone workspace around CorridorKey 2.0 for subject masks and full-resolution RGBA matting, with automatic GPU memory planning. This is a packaged preview; the latest installer has not had an end-to-end installation test.
tools.requirements: Windows 10/11 x64 · NVIDIA RTX 30-series or newer · About 25 GB free · Internet for models
tools.install: Run the online setup. It downloads missing pinned runtime and model dependencies; the download size is much larger than the installer. CorridorKey uses Corridor Digital’s Corridor Key Licence v2.0, including noncommercial terms. Review the licence shown by setup before use.

readiness.evidence: EVFX Corridor Key 2.0/dist/standalone/START HERE.txt: Delivery Status.
readiness.note: Experimental: installation and the complete matting workflow are untested. May be unstable.
